x-admonition.title: Milvus version compatibility
x-admonition.content: Server-side sorting, grouping, and search aggregation parameters (orderByFields, groupByFields, searchAggregation) take effect only on clusters compatible with Milvus v3.0.x or later. On Zilliz Cloud, serverless clusters are compatible with Milvus v3.0.x, while Dedicated clusters are compatible with Milvus v2.6.x unless upgraded to the v3.0.x Public Preview.

zh-CN.title: Milvus 版本兼容性
zh-CN.content: 服务端排序、分组与搜索聚合参数（orderByFields、groupByFields、searchAggregation）仅在与 Milvus v3.0.x 或更高版本兼容的集群上生效。在 Zilliz Cloud 上，Serverless 集群与 Milvus v3.0.x 兼容；Dedicated 集群默认与 Milvus v2.6.x 兼容，升级至 v3.0.x Public Preview 后可用。

ja-JP.title: Milvus バージョンの互換性
ja-JP.content: サーバーサイドのソート、グループ化、および検索集約のパラメータ（orderByFields、groupByFields、searchAggregation）は、Milvus v3.0.x 以降と互換性のあるクラスターでのみ有効です。Zilliz Cloud では、サーバーレスクラスタは Milvus v3.0.x と互換性があり、Dedicated クラスタは v3.0.x Public Preview にアップグレードしない限り Milvus v2.6.x と互換性があります。

x-admonition.title: Milvus version compatibility
x-admonition.content: Server-side sorting, grouping, and search aggregation parameters (orderByFields, groupByFields, searchAggregation) take effect only on clusters compatible with Milvus v3.0.x or later. zh-CN.title: Milvus 版本兼容性
zh-CN.content: 服务端排序、分组与搜索聚合参数（orderByFields、groupByFields、searchAggregation）仅在与 Milvus v3.0.x 或更高版本兼容的集群上生效。在 Zilliz Cloud 上，Serverless 集群与 Milvus v3.0.x 兼容；Dedicated 集群默认与 Milvus v2.6.x 兼容，升级至 v3.0.x Public Preview 后可用。

ja-JP.content: サーバーサイドのソート、グループ化、および検索集約のパラメータ（orderByFields、groupByFields、searchAggregation）は、Milvus v3.0.x 以降と互換性のあるクラスターでのみ有効です。Zilliz Cloud では、サーバーレスクラスタは Milvus v3.0.x と互換性があり、Dedicated クラスタは v3.0.x Public Preview にアップグレードしない限り Milvus v2.6.x と互換性があります。

x-admonition.title: Milvus version compatibility
x-admonition.content: Server-side sorting, grouping, and search aggregation parameters (orderByFields, groupByFields, searchAggregation) take effect only on clusters compatible with Milvus v3.0.x or later. On Zilliz Cloud, serverless clusters are compatible with Milvus v3.0.x, while Dedicated clusters are compatible with Milvus v2.6.x unless upgraded to the v3.0.x Public Preview.

zh-CN.title: Milvus 版本兼容性
zh-CN.content: 服务端排序、分组与搜索聚合参数（orderByFields、groupByFields、searchAggregation）仅在与 Milvus v3.0.x 或更高版本兼容的集群上生效。在 Zilliz Cloud 上，Serverless 集群与 Milvus v3.0.x 兼容；Dedicated 集群默认与 Milvus v2.6.x 兼容，升级至 v3.0.x Public Preview 后可用。

ja-JP.title: Milvus バージョンの互換性
ja-JP.content: サーバーサイドのソート、グループ化、および検索集約のパラメータ（orderByFields、groupByFields、searchAggregation）は、Milvus v3.0.x 以降と互換性のあるクラスターでのみ有効です。Zilliz Cloud では、サーバーレスクラスタは Milvus v3.0.x と互換性があり、Dedicated クラスタは v3.0.x Public Preview にアップグレードしない限り Milvus v2.6.x と互換性があります。

FloatVectorEncodingHeader.name: Accept-Type-Float-Vector-Encoding
FloatVectorEncodingHeader.description:
Controls the response encoding of returned `FLOAT_VECTOR` fields in non-aggregation results, including those nested in struct arrays. Use `array` (default) for JSON arrays of numbers or `base64` for Base64 strings. Other vector types, scalar fields, and dynamic-field arrays keep their existing representation. This header does not change the encoding of request data.

The header does not apply to `searchAggregation` results. In aggregation `topHits`, `FLOAT_VECTOR` fields retain their existing string representation, such as `"[0.1 0.2]"`, even when the header is `base64`.

With `base64`, each string contains the standard padded Base64 encoding of the vector coordinates as little-endian IEEE 754 float32 bytes, in their original order. Decode the string to bytes, then interpret each group of four bytes as a little-endian float32 value. Base64 mode rejects NaN and positive or negative infinity in returned coordinates.

Null vector values remain JSON `null` in both modes. If a non-null, zero-length vector reaches serialization, it encodes as `[]` in `array` mode and `""` in `base64` mode. Milvus still requires positive vector dimensions. Fields not returned by the query remain absent from the response entity.

Values are case-sensitive. An omitted or empty value uses `array`; leading and trailing spaces or tabs are ignored. Supply the header only once. Unsupported values, comma-separated value lists, or repeated header fields (even with identical values) return HTTP 200 with response body `code: 1100` (invalid parameter).

x-admonition.title: Decode a Base64 float vector
x-admonition.content:
Include the FLOAT_VECTOR field in outputFields and add this header to your request:

Accept-Type-Float-Vector-Encoding: base64

For a field named vector containing [1.0, -2.0], the response entity contains:

{"vector": "AACAPwAAAMA="}

Decode the value in Python:

import base64
import struct

raw = base64.b64decode("AACAPwAAAMA=")
vector = list(struct.unpack(f"<{len(raw) // 4}f", raw))
# [1.0, -2.0]
